Usage: ocfl init-root [flags]

Create a new OCFL storage root

Flags:
  -h, --help                  Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING           The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root used
                              for the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug                 enable debug log messages

  -l, --layout="0004-hashed-n-tuple-storage-layout"
                              The storage root layout extension (see
                              https://ocfl.github.io/extensions/).
  -d, --description=STRING    Description to include in the storage root
                              metadata
      --ocflv="1.1"           OCFL version for the storage root
      --existing-ok           don't return an error if a storage root already
                              exists at the location
